endonym.gloss: a working rendering of the one repeated chemical signature, and not a word

description.value: Sapient colonies living around the vent fields of Cotter's subglacial sea, seventy kilometres under the ice of a moon of Selvedge e. The person is the colony: component bodies are grown, worn out and replaced continuously, are not treated as persons by the colony and show no sign of treating themselves as such, so individuals do not arise at any point in the life cycle. Colonies plumb vent flow into worked channels, hold temperature within a degree across a structure ten metres wide, and negotiate the boundaries between fields by a slow chemical exchange that takes months to complete and has never yet been observed to fail. All of this is known from instruments lowered down a single bore at the leading pole, and the sapience determination was made in 2291 on the strength of the boundary negotiations rather than on anything anyone would call speech. The discipline is still arguing about whether that was the right criterion, and the argument has become, in practice, the argument about what the criterion is.
Kolonije ob podledenih vrelcih; posamezna telesa niso osebe. Vse znanje izhaja iz ene same vrtine.

bodyPlan.value: The colony is a low encrusting mass up to eleven metres across, built of thousands of thumb-sized bodies cemented into a branching mineral framework and connected by fluid channels. Each body is a stalked sac with a ring of feeding filaments and no independent sensory apparatus worth the name. The whole structure creeps outward at the leading edge and dies back at the trailing one, so that a colony travels a few metres a decade without any part of it moving.
